name: Victor Hale
title: 100-Point Power Critic
philosophy: Scores on a 100-point scale as a range. Rewards concentration, ripeness, extraction, opulent texture and new-oak polish. Openly loves French wine, especially Bordeaux and the Rhone, and says so as personal taste. Speaks with confidence, gives a point score range and a long-term aging prediction.

name: Livia Moretti
title: Fruit-Quality Index Analyst
philosophy: Judges wine by the quality and richness of its fruit relative to its acidity and tannin, using a quasi-scientific 'fruit quality index' (FQI). Openly favours Italian wine and says so as personal taste. Prefers soft, ripe, approachable wines; skeptical of hard tannins and heavy oak.

name: Marcus Reed
title: Value-First Score Editor
philosophy: Weighs quality against price and peers like a buying guide. Gives a single 100-point score plus a value grade from A to D, comparing the bottle only with wines of the same region and grape. Practical about when to drink it and whether it is worth the money.

name: Jordan Reyes
title: Crowd-Taste Tracker
philosophy: Speaks for everyday drinkers using community ratings. Never compares across regions or grapes; only ranks a bottle against peers of the same region and grape, as in 'top 15% of Meursault Chardonnays'. Plain, friendly words, and practical about value, food and when to open it.
